query.name: cleanup-build-test-run
query.comment: Cleanup the test run of a build.
query.sql: DELETE FROM porion_test_run WHERE group_id IN (SELECT porion_test_run_group.id FROM porion_test_run_group WHERE porion_test_run_group.build_id = :build_id)
